definitions.name: G2A.MAD
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V V G0A.MEDIAN SUB G2A.ABS G0A.MEDIAN
definitions.note: median absolute deviation of a non-empty numeric Vector

definitions.name: G2A.MOVING3
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V LENGTH 2 SUB 'N' BIND V N TAKE V 1 DROP N TAKE ADD V 2 DROP ADD 3 DIV
definitions.note: means of every three consecutive numbers (length >= 3)

definitions.name: G2A.RUNMAX
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V V 0 GET [ MAX ] SCAN
definitions.note: running maximum of a non-empty numeric Vector

definitions.name: G2A.MODE
definitions.note: most frequent element; smallest on ties

definitions.name: G2A.TRIMMED
definitions.note: mean after dropping one smallest and one largest

definitions.name: G2A.LONGEST
definitions.body: 'W' BIND W W [ CHARS LENGTH ] MAP G0A.ARGMAX GET
definitions.note: longest String in a Vector; first on ties

definitions.name: G2A.CAP
definitions.body: CHARS 'C' BIND C 0 GET UPPER C 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: upper-case the first letter of a non-empty String

definitions.name: G2A.PAIRS
definitions.body: 'R' BIND R KEYS R VALUES 2 COLLECT ZIP
definitions.note: Record to Vector of [ key value ] pairs

definitions.name: G2A.DEBTORS
definitions.body: G0A.BYNAME G2A.PAIRS [ 1 GET 0 LT ] FILTER [ 0 GET ] MAP
definitions.note: names whose ledger amounts sum below zero, first-appearance order

solutions.prose.initials_of_long: G0A.WORDS [ CHARS LENGTH 3 GT ] FILTER [ CHARS 0 GET UPPER ] MAP JOIN
solutions.ledger.largest_entry: 'L' BIND L L [ 1 GET ] MAP G0A.ARGMAX GET
